title: Angel of Faith, 1 dollar

specs.Decoration: microprinting, digital printing, transparent capsule containing a silver 24-carat gold-plated filigree insert

descriptionPlain: Description Unconventional gift for a loved one Symbol of the protective power of angels Photographic-quality digital printing Undisputed collectible value Angels are the embodiment of goodness and sincerity of heart. We believe that they watch over us, care for a better tomorrow, and guard us on the way to God. The exquisitely decorated silver coin „Angel of Faith,” given to a loved one, will become a lucky talisman that will always remind them of your warm feelings and care.
